newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Kian Ann buys 51 pct of Transmec shares.
newsitem.headline: Kian Ann buys 51 pct of Transmec shares.

text.p: Kian Ann Engineering Ltd said on Tuesday it bought 51 percent of the issued share capital of Transmec Engineering Pte Ltd for Singapore $1.6 million.
The agreement involved the acquisition of 647,700 ordinary shares of $1.00 each, fully paid up, in the share capital of Transmec Engineering, Kian Ann said in a statement.
Transmec has an authorised share capital of $2 million divided into two million shares of $1.00 each, and 1.27 million ordinary shares of $1.00 each have been issued and fully paid up.
Transmec's main business is the manufacturing of engineering parts and engineering services.
It said the acquisition was not expected to have a material effect on the net tangible assets per share and earnings per share of the company for its financial year ending June 30.
